notes.title: Happy International Workers' Day ! V1.06 Released !
notes.content:
Hi,Dear fellews

In a blink of an eye, the International workers' Day vacation is coming! Will you choose to go on a long-lost trip, or stay at home and play Zomday? We worked hard to complete this update patch before 51, I hope you will like it!


Here is the change list:


[h3][b]1. 
Fixed an issue that could cause disconnection after generating zombies or hitting zombies[/b][/h3]

After the last update, some players reacted to the problem that the client will be dropped when shooting enemies. We have fixed and optimized this problem. It is now suspected that when the monster initializes the application of physical bone logic, the speed of the client is faster than that of the host, which triggers a logical error and causes a disconnection. We will continue to pay attention to this problem, if you still encounter this problem after this update, please inform us in time.



[h3][b]2. New Ammo UI。（Beta）[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29977407/579277a36739a22e1d97f26518c211604311cea4.png[/img]

In this update, we added a new feature, the Ammo UI. This function is still in the testing stage, we hope to continue to develop this set of functions, so as to maximize the replacement of the UI in front of the camera.


[h3][b]3.
Hardcore mode reload animation covering all firearms[/b][/h3]

Now in hardcore mode, all weapons will have an animation of the magazine inhalation reaction when inserted into the magazine.



[h3][b]4. 
Hardcore mode weapon operation optimization[/b][/h3]


a. After inserting the magazine for a short period of time (0.5 seconds), you cannot immediately eject the magazine . This is to prevent misoperation. 


b. In the dual-hold state, when the left hand is close to the main hand, the rate of controlling the rotation of the firearm will be reduced to prevent excessive rapid rotation.


c.After using the reload key to cancel the bolt catch , in a short period of time (0.5 seconds)  you cannot immediately eject the magazine . This is to prevent misoperation.


d. In some cases, the bolt dragging logic failure . This problem has now been optimized. 


e. Now you can't eject the mag when firing。        


[h3][b]5.
Added projectile effects for machine gun turret and shotgun turret[/b][/h3]

The scene is even hotter!


[h3][b]6.
Adjusted the brightness of the Lv3 and Lv3 challenge levels[/b][/h3]


[h3][b]7. 
Completely turn off SnapTurn or SmoothTurn[/b][/h3]

If you want to turn off Snapturn or SmoothTurn completely, now set the rotation angle / speed value to 0, then both SnapTurn and SmoothTurn will be turned off.


[h3][b]8. 
Add window in front options[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29977407/07bfa9d757128b9ef61d59fc4c67a93f8f1745ba.png[/img]

This option will turn on or off the forced front of the game window. After setting, you need to restart the game to make it take effect.


[h3][b]9. 
Weapon level 7-8 upgrade difficulty adjustment[/b][/h3]

Now the experience required to upgrade weapons from level 7 to level 8 has been halved.


[h3][b]10. 
Lv3 challenge Robot's health initialization bug fix[/b][/h3]




I wish you all a happy holiday and fun!



INTOGAMES

notes.title: V1.05 Release! Rework hardcore mode magazine insert logic,Cheating prevent etc.
notes.content:

又到了周更的时间！本次更新依旧根据玩家的反馈对游戏中的各种问题进行优化和调整。好了，废话不多说，以下是更新列表：

[h1][b]1. Rework hardcore mode magazine insert logic[/b][/h1]

Many players have complained more than once that the mag insertion in hardcore mode is very uncomfortable. Now, we have substantially revised the cartridge insertion in hard core mode. The judgment of the current magazine insertion is very loose, you can easily insert the magazine! This process will be very smooth.
We will continue to optimize the operation of the hard core mode next!

[h1][b]2. Duplicate weapon in multiplay prevent logic[/b][/h1]

After several versions of testing, we formally added a set of mechanisms to prevent the use of multiplayer network delays for weapon replication. We hope that this mechanism will allow everyone to enjoy reasonable game fun in multiplayer mode, and will not be affected by the cheating. This system is still under test, you are welcome to continue to give us more feedback.

[h1][b]3. Turret adjust[/b][/h1]

The initial health of the turret has been increased，6k/5k/7k/9k（Flame/Laser/MachineGun/Shotgun）。  
The cost of each repair is reduced to 500
After each wave is over, the turret will be automatically restored to full health!

[h3][b]4.Fixed bug where client players were not be harmed[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]5.Fixed the bug that the chainsaw does not unlock[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]6.Fixed a bug where players might not die after being thrown into the abyss in the fifth level[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]7.Fixed a bug that prevented double damage during bullet time[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]8.
Optimized the grenade model to reduce rendering costs. Even if there are a lot of grenade in the scene, the effect on the frame number is very low.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]9.
Eliminate some variables that affect network consumption.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]10.
Adjust the Spider Boss‘ health in Level 5. Now the gameplay is more reasonable.[/b][/h3]

Due to the preparation of our studio site to be relocated, next week's update will be postponed until the following week to merge and release! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Weekly update！V1.041 released，optimize and bug fix ！Rework the Shotgun reload ！
notes.content:
Hi, fellows

This week's update continues to optimize and fix bugs. We completed the higher priority tasks as quickly as possible within a week.
Due to time constraints, if this update does not cover the update you are expecting, please understand.

Here is the update list:

[b]1.Rework the Shotgun reload in hardcore mode[/b]

First of all, thank you very much for your feedback. The reload logic of the original shotgun in hard core mode will be greatly affected by the frame rate. This leads to a wrong judgment of the shot when the shotgun is used to shoot under certain circumstances when the frame rate is changing violently. . After receiving a lot of complaints from players, we redesigned the reload logic of the shotgun in hard core mode. This new set of logic will work properly even if the frame rate is unstable.
We will continue to optimize the reload of other weapons in hardcore mode!

[b]2.Error correction in tutorial and text beautification[/b]

This is also a problem that many new players react to. We have fixed this problem, and beautified the fonts that appear in the teaching tips of the teaching concept, and also optimized the teaching interaction.
We will continue to optimize teaching tips for different types of VR devices.

[b]3.Snap turn/Smooth turn system Rework[/b]

This is also a problem that many new players react to. 
In this update, we reworked the system of snap turn and smooth turn. After this update, players will be able to customize the rotation angle and speed as well as the rotation method.
Here is the detail：

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29977407/b84cddc8e727b6b35095f0e220798639cf63f3f8.png[/img]

The content marked with a red frame in the picture is the content of this modification

[b]---Snap Turn switch---[/b]

When the Snap turn is [b]On[/b],
Each turn will rotate left or right at a fixed angle. The angle of rotation to the left or right depends on the value of "Turn Speed ​​/ Angle".
When this value is 90, your left or right turn will be 90 degrees, when this value is 45 , your left or right turn will be 45 degrees. 

When the Snap turn is [b]Off[/b],
Your turn will become smooth turn. The turning speed is depends on the value of "Turn Speed ​​/ Angle".
The larger the value, the faster the rotation speed.

[b]---Touch Locomotion/Turn---[/b]

The default is off. When this option is on, you can locomotion and rotation by touching the touchpad without pressing the touchpad.
We do not recommend turning on this option for devices with a joystick.

[b]4.Fix the Snipe penetrate bug[/b]
Thanks to “Ger-Todbringer” . 
His feedback made us notice this problem. Now this bug has been fixed.

[b]5.
Fixed a bug where the position of the gun did not respond when debugging the position of the gun in the "Gun Position" system settings[/b]

[b]6.
Optimized the  player's head and hands’ synchronize logic, which can greatly reduce the consumption of network transmission.[/b]

[b]7.
The detection range of the player's rear gun slot has been widened. It will be easier to take the sniper rifle from behind.[/b]

[b]8.
Improve the execution efficiency of player's hand detection logic.[/b]

[b]9.
Optimized the execution efficiency of logic in AI[/b]


We will continue to listen to players' opinions and feedback to optimize the official version. We expect to launch some non-maintenance updates after three or four minor maintenance updates. Everyone's opinions and feedback can leave a message under this topic, our development team will read your opinions carefully.

notes.title: Beta 1.5 released ! HardCore mode, extra perk bonus, dismember, new weapons, and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/9ecc32dcc38a54a1267bba691055df56b50e5a91.jpg[/img]

Hi,Dear fellows!


The Spring Festival is near, we have been preparing and testing for a long time, and now release the Zomday Beta 1.5 version!
In this release, we officially launched the long-awaited hardcore model. In the hard core mode, all gun operations will be consistent with the real world of gun operations, allowing everyone to truly experience a "doomsday zombie survival simulation." We have also added zombie dismember, hit recover, and dodging systems, and now the zombie's response will be more realistic. In addition, network reconnection, optimization, online bug fixes and other updates will be released in this update! Please see the list of update changes below.


[h1][b]1.	Hardcore Mode[/b][/h1]

Hardcore mode is the highlight of this update! When the hard core mode is turned on, the game's operating mechanism will change a lot. Let's take a closer look at the hard core mode:

You can turn it on in the main menu ! The upper right corner button.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/abf72c7f2d07757d6cc3ea0b91f839d1192cd066.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]A.[/b][/h1]	
All firearms operations simulate the real firearm operation to the greatest extent. Players need to use both hands to reload magazine. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/63f6022ae0092b9cec6fe4beb98dcf108c5a03a0.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/14038e0361581ad165be66c7a51030aff83c51cb.gif[/img]

[h1][b]B.[/b][/h1]	
Use the grip button to perform all gun operations, including pulling the slider, the bolt, or pulling the magazine out.

[h1][b]C.[/b][/h1]
At the same time as the gun is taken, a magazine will spawn. The clip can be grabbed to reload a weapon or throw it into the world. In other words, players in hardcore mode can drop the clips into the world and share it to the other players. It should be noted that if you drop directly at your own feet, you will be regained the ammunition yourself, just like picking up (step on) the ammo boxes in the world. So, when you want to share ammunition with your teammates, please find a higher table and put it on~

[i] Share ammo	[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/f952ab3d2e6d414c60be1c6f4b561280fff9d785.gif[/img]

[h1][b]D.[/b][/h1]
Press the reload button to eject the magazine. When your weapon is bolt catching, you can press the reload button to do a bolt release. This will save your time instead of pulling the bolt again.

[i]AR Series: Press the reload button to do a bolt release instead of pulling the bolt handle.[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/ec1973ec307ae8a08d06b01fec06b697ddb2eced.gif[/img]

[i]AK Series: Had to pull the bolt to make the bullet into the chamber since it can't bolt catch.[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/24e0ef1bcf615c597846bd9baf6cdf5cacbff2a2.gif[/img]



[h1][b]E.[/b][/h1]
Auto grip will be Off. You have to grip the gun handle by manual. 

[h1][b]F.[/b][/h1]
Weapon shooting damage X 2

[h1][b]G.[/b][/h1]
The shotgun damage can reaches 6 times if you are shooting something in a almost 0 meter distance.
After this patch,the damage of the shotgun will have a 10 meter distance attenuation calculation:

For example, the base damage of a shotgun is 10 . After entering the hard core mode, the base damage becomes 10x2 = 20. Shooting enemies 10 meters away, the damage value is 20, and if you are shooting at a distance of 0 meters, the damage value is 20x3 = 60. By analogy, the damage of a shotgun in hard core mode will change between x2 and x6 within a distance of 10 meters. 
The damage distance attenuation also applies to shotguns in non-hard core mode, but the power will change between x1 and X3.

[i] Shotgun damage attenuation --- first shot:44   second shot:57   third shot: 80  fourth shot: 100  	[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/d6442f73581f7c675786099e65d5d9cc3b484b18.gif[/img]



[h1][b]H.[/b][/h1]	
You have to reload the bolt action shotgun one shell at a time until it's full

[h1][b]I.[/b][/h1]
How to pull the shotgun's bolt:
As the Gif below,Grip the handle first, and then holding the left hand trigger, pull back and forward. It sounds a little bit complex but it is to prevent the misoperation when we are moving fast.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/710562b68f1c9dee2c67c2743f2d7c1a0e85c4a8.gif[/img]


[h1][b]J.[/b][/h1]	
Now you can Offhand reloading/bolting:
As the Gif below, hold your weapon first and then press the right hand grip button , after that your main hand will leave the weapon (pistol Not included)

[i]Recontrol the weapon after offhand	[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/0064ec445fd3b3eae126abe91d3bafa69b0ab35c.gif[/img]

[i]Reload a manual operation rifle	[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/c3cbfca97d6188be5bb1fe80b65807472fc20972.gif[/img]

[i]Pull mag out then reload a manual operation rifle	[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/c9e2f7d0fe4ab7b4893af2ab2ce56b96c55f9fe5.gif[/img]

[i]Reload a shotgun when offhand[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/5629fe0b09b22fc77b2fc017309563026bedb1d8.gif[/img]

[i]Dropping a weapon when offhand	[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/7a8325696d6717d0d07e2343d8feb7504b94f3a2.gif[/img]

[h1][b]K.[/b][/h1]	
When you are doing a Offhand, there will be some limits:

Hi! Dear friends,
 2019 has arrived, all of our INTOGAMES colleagues here to extend a beautiful blessing to the New Year! Thank you for your continued support of ZomDay, so that our team can grow smoothly. After the release of the last Halloween development status post, it has been nearly a month. In this news post, we continue to introduce the development status of the manual reload in the hard core mode.

[h1][b]1.The reload of pump action shotgun[/b][/h1]

As in the real case, the shotgun that uses the tubular magazine to store the shell must manually press the shell into the magazine one by one. When your right hand picks up the weapon,a magazine (or bullet) will be generated in the mag slot.

You can fire as fast as you can since it is all manually.

[h1][b]2.The reload of semi-automatic shotgun[/b][/h1]
Is Benelli M4. It has a little difference with a pump action shotgun since it can bolt action:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/787da3dc613bb8dcdb01f75cc99e0c6884229ff4.gif[/img]
When bolt catching , player can put the shell directly into the bolt when the bolt is open.

[h1][b]3.Double barrel shotgun[/b][/h1]
So it is DT11:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/2bd304ba591bda2c9539bec9bc670c5162e49c94.gif[/img]
You may notice that i'm swing the barrel to close it :) And of course you can also use the reload button to close the barrel.

[h1][b]4.The reload after bolt catch[/b][/h1]
Here is the reload process gif of M1911:
The first way is press the reload button after mag inserted. You can see the slider and bolt will go back to fire position.
The second way is dragging the slider and release(or manually push back) , the slider will go back to fire position.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/63f6022ae0092b9cec6fe4beb98dcf108c5a03a0.gif[/img]

[h1][b]5.The reload of assault rifle[/b][/h1]
AKM：
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/24e0ef1bcf615c597846bd9baf6cdf5cacbff2a2.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/e021583fb6c652503ff1d200b8123b723bccb907.gif[/img]

[h1][b]6.The balance of Hardcore mode[/b][/h1]

When our players turn on the hard core mode, the DPS reduction caused by the manual operation will make the game more difficult, so we will balance the numerical calculation.
The value of the damage is an example. After the hard mode is turned on, the base damage of the firearm will increase. Also, distance-based attenuation will be added for shotgun weapons, and the closer the distance is, the higher the damage.

More numerical balances are still under discussion, including greater benefits, and the ultimate goal is to make the hardcore model a more attractive mode for players - :)

[u][b]But an important thing is the players who are using hardcore mode can play with players who are using arcade mode(default mdoe) in a multiplay. [/b][/u]


[h1][b]7.About when？[/b][/h1]
At present, the logic part of  manual operation program has been completed, and the next work will focus on the numerical calculation part.
I really hope we can release this new version before Chinese lunar new year
...... X_X

[h1][b]
    
　　Very embarrassing, this year, we received a lot of commercial projects for the livelihood of the studio, and only did a little work on ZomDay.

　　But，

　　Let us embrace the 2019 with confidence and expectation

　　Bless you all!

　　Thank you！[/b][/h1]

notes.title: ZomDay Anniversary ! Beta1.4 released！8 players game supported,two hand weapon system,new level and more!
notes.content:
[b]First of all we must thank you for your support of ZomDay! 
It is everyone's love for ZomDay that will make this game perfect and give us more energy![/b]ːsteamhappyː

Now we can be proud to announce ：
------------------------------[h1][b]:peace:Happy ZomDay Anniversary！:peace:[/b][/h1]   ------------------------------

[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/b1ee072c980a9ab1c70fa4b98f28788679276f00.jpg[/img]


After reading the anniversary comics, let's take a look at what's in this update :)

Over the past few months, the ZomDay team has massively upgraded the entire GamePlay and network system architecture and fixed a number of bugs. Thanks to these upgrades, this update will bring you many new features that players have been waiting for for a long time!

[h1][b] 
1. New feature: 8 players multiplay[/b][/h1] 
  
  Thanks to the optimization of the gameplay framework, ZomDay will officially support 8 people online at the same time! The delay in shooting due to slow network or the problem of not being able to shoot the gun will not occur again. Call your teammates! But don't be too happy, the difficulty of the level will still increase dynamically with the increase of the number of people. Focusing on cooperation is the key to customs clearance.。

[h1][b]2.New feature：Room with access code，Room hoster name display，level difficulty information etc. [/b][/h1]  
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/7aee0fa5250bec2e5ffa4caf810126fca7de5d14.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/6a32b3c3e2cc2f2e5c6b167aa96c20ea0eb936ff.jpg[/img]

[h1][b] 3.New feature：Weapon recoil system upgrade[/b][/h1]   

The upgraded recoil system will accumulate the angle and offset caused by the recoil. [b][u] This means that the muzzle of an uncontrolled continuous shot will continue to jump, and the accuracy of the shot will be greatly reduced.[/u][/b] 



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/3c890dd82553f5218530201f1bc1195b933619ba.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/d1962dd7393befed462d6339f4e3977c7a2b0f68.gif[/img]

[h1][b]4.New feature：Two hand weapon system（Alpha）[/b][/h1]   

It's here! The new two hand weapon system! When the weapon enters dual-hold, the recoil of the muzzle and spread of the projectile will be significantly reduced.

 	
[h1]a.Use the "grip key" to align with the part of the weapon that can be grasped to enter the dual-hold mode.
b.Press the "grasp key" again to exit the double-hold state
c.The holding hand can't do anything until your release it.(press Grip key again)
d.For OC, you must holding the Grip to keep holding.
[/h1]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/2284274cc1cc0278e49070cb82dd25e768d64eb3.gif[/img]

Attention，the holding of rifle weapon is different from a pistom weapon：
Rifle：
         [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/99a26e0b8222ae5223ffebd820caede37adb7b11.gif[/img]

This feature is still being perfected, please give your opinion and help us improve it！

[h1][b]5.Update：	The calculation of melee attacks！[/b][/h1]   
  Melee weapons will continue to inflict damage as they swipe across the enemy's body. So all melee attacks are significantly more powerful.

[h1][b]6.Optimize：	Up to 20% to 30% improvement in rendering performance！[/b][/h1]   
  These optimizations will greatly enhance the player's smooth experience, especially when multiple people are online, and these features will support more enemies and players rendering on the same screen.

[h1][b]7.Update：	Physics hit reaction [/b][/h1]  
  The dynamic response of the monster is more natural after being hit, and the monster model will no longer be overstretched when attacking zombies with a high speed machine gun.

[h1][b]8.Update：	Client grenade throwing bug fixed/Hand grenade throwing tips [/b][/h1]  
  Benefit from architecture upgrades，[u]Client players in multiplayer mode will no longer have trouble throwing grenades.[/u]And new hand grenade throwing tips.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/060675e9f4b3b3c7cb161e073f81a1cdd12f3efc.gif[/img]

[h1][b]9.Update：	New challenge level 4 --- Disturbia   [/b][/h1]  
  Experience this new level of challenge! You will unlock a new weapon after passing this level!

[h1][b]10.Update：	New 10+ Achievements [/b][/h1]  

[h1][b]11.New Feature：	Tracker mode（Alpha） [/b][/h1] 
  Now ZomDay will have native Tracker support, you don't need to turn Tracker into Controller anymore! Easy to use custom devices such like PPGun. This is helpful for a large numbers of arcade shops using custom peripherals.

This feature is still under development, and you should be aware of the following：
a.
 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/d1858527d05b9fe75e742cda821b9fbe99fb671b.jpg[/img]

c.You still need to turn on the PPGun mode, otherwise this feature will not work

d.If you still want to keep the Tracker as Controller, you don't need to make any changes。

e.Tracker will be your right hand, and the Controller will be your left hand.


[h1][b]12.New Feature：	KillingRank。 [/b][/h1] 
  At the end of each wave, all players on the scene will now show their kill rankings.
[img]https://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/10c72dfb5fd8415bd35f7d7fc2f507c7cbc0ddae.jpg[/img]

notes.title: How is the rating calculated?
notes.content:
Hi, dear all!

When guys talked about the game recently, they often asked questions about the rating, wanted to know how the rating was calculated, and how to make a high rating. The following will briefly introduce the calculation method of the rating and some tips. I hope all guys will have the ideal rating in their hearts after reading!ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Ratings are calculated by:[/h1]
[b]Number of head shot [/b], [b]number of combo[/b], [b]hit rate[/b], and the amount of injury. There are four factors, each factor has 25 points, a total of 100 points.

[h1]How to calculate the rating:[/h1]
Each factor has a [b]reference value[/b] that equals or exceeds the [b]reference value[/b] to get a perfect score. Below the [b]reference value,[/b] the score decays proportionally. Head shot, combo, and hit rate are the higher the score is, but the  amount of injury. [u]Four factors are independent of each other, for example, if the number of head shot is 0, and the other three items are full marks, the highest score will only be 75 points.[/u] Each time a wave is counted, the data is cleared when the next wave begin. A total score of more than 90 points can be obtained [b]Ω[/b], more than 80 points less than 90 to get [b]SSS[/b], and so on;

[h1]High score essential skills:[/h1]
1. Crazy head shot.
2. Infinite combo (no more than three seconds without hitting an enemy or a bullet does not hit the enemy and the combo will break).
3. Unhurt.

[h1]High score tips:[/h1]
1. When you want a higher number of head shot, try attack bigger and not blocked head, such as gorillas. . .
2. Attack the dead body of zombies, combo also be calculated. 
3. Try not be hurt. Theoretically, this score is the easiest to get.
4. Want to win [b]Ω[/b]? Try get the 'clock22' to challenge the 'god of war'!ːsteamhappyː

Enjoy!
INTOGAMES

notes.title: Beta1.05 Released
notes.content:
Hi,Gamers
Beta 1.05 is here! There’re many new features and bug fixing in this version. There are so many things to deal with before ZomDay formally release on steam. We hope you like it! 
Here is the change list:

1.	Gun Stock Attack:
Now you can use gun stock to strike your enemy! Attention! This means you need to really close to them and take risk.
As same as melee weapon the faster you wave the more damage you make.
Different guns have different types of gun stock. So remember your attack distance.
Try to use your gun stock like a bad ass.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/bdf85c247c2300e0984071ddd9d3a1204cd2df8c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/db8ce4721ed18b7ecde522ba8e9dade9f87eb9d3.jpg[/img]



2.	New Weapon: Nano Acid Grenade
After the battle of abandoned factory our researcher recycle the dead body of monster gorilla. They turn the green toxin in the dead body into a kind of DNA weapon only aim for monsters.
When the Nano Acid Grenade exploded it release a tons of Nano particle in a 6 meter radius. This lasts for 5s and do damage to the enemy inside.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29977407/19afff798c5c8f547a4aa93487887c01e95492e8.jpg[/img]


3.	New function: Custom HUD (alpha 0.5)
This is a developing function. In the final version you can custom HUD’s location and ON/OFF.
In this version you can only defy HUD’s ON/OFF.
You can find it in ‘Option’-‘System Option’

4.	New Function：Pause
Press the ‘Space’ key will pause the game!
Attention! You can not pause in the multiple player game.

5.	Update: When the boss’s dead all the enemy dead as well.

6.	Bug fixed: Controllers now shake normally when firing two guns at the same time.

7.	Bug fixed: SVD with scope on the gun collection board now looks normally.
